{{Quote|Well! You don't look like you're part of Shug's little Gamorrean clan.|Gayem Leksende speaks to a Republic citizen|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Shurg]] led a '''Gamorrean clan''' that controlled an abandoned [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Jundland Czerka facility|facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} [[Shurg]]'s clan appears during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] World Arc on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which is first accessible to the three aforementioned classes when they first visit Tatooine during Act I. Therefore, it can be inferred the events involving the clan happen around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Czerka required data stored at the abandoned facility. Czerka official [[Gayem Leksende]] made a deal with Shurg; in return for access to the data, the clan would be given weapons and [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]].<ref name="TOR" />
